message: I remember the last time we had a blackout, and it felt like a scene from a movie. Just as I was about to stream my favorite show, the lights flickered and went out. My phone was at 20%, and I realized I hadn’t charged my power bank in ages. I dug out our trusty lantern instead, and we spent the evening playing board games by its glow. It reminded me that a little planning goes a long way! How do you stay connected when the power goes out?
